facts.fact: Finnfund (Finland) signed a USD 10 million mezzanine commitment to Communication and Renewable Energy Infrastructure (CREI), a Mauritius-registered company providing solar-hybrid energy as a service to MTN South Sudan's 499 sites, within USD 25 million total project financing (Finnfund share 40%), per Finnfund's disclosure.
Finnfund (Finland) signed a USD 5 million loan to Communication and Renewable Energy Infrastructure (CREI) for its South Sudan telecom energy business, listed by Finnfund among its other investments.

systems.platform: solar-hybrid energy as a service, 10-year ESCO contract
